Body.Content:
The Azure Functions experience is now generally available, including the consumption compute model (formerly called "dynamic compute").

We've also announced:

  • A simpler billing model.
  • A preview version of the Azure Functions CLI for a local development experience.

For more details, see our GA announcement and the product page.
